description: This source file implements the MessageClient class within the WPEFramework::Messaging namespace. It manages message buffers, factories for message deserialization, and provides methods for adding/removing instances, waiting for updates, skipping waiting, enabling/disabling messages, controlling message settings, and processing messages by calling a handler function.

classes.name: MessageClient
classes.description: A class that manages message buffers, factories, and message processing for inter-component communication within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: MessageClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MessageClient with identifier, base path, and socket port.

methods.name: AddInstance
methods.description: Adds a message buffer instance for a given ID.

methods.name: RemoveInstance
methods.description: Removes the message buffer instance for a given ID.

methods.name: WaitForUpdates
methods.description: Blocks until there are updates in any of the message buffers or the wait time expires.

methods.name: SkipWaiting
methods.description: Forces the waiting to stop, effectively flushing or interrupting the wait.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables messages based on metadata.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current message controls.

methods.name: PopMessagesAndCall
methods.description: Pops all messages from buffers and calls a handler function for each message.

methods.name: AddFactory
methods.description: Registers a factory for a specific message type.

methods.name: RemoveFactory
methods.description: Unregisters the factory for a specific message type.
